title: 2019 AIAA SciTech presentation, slides 4 to 9
summary: Salvatore Pais tells of 2019 AIAA SciTech presentation, slides 4 to 9, about 2019 at AIAA SciTech, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: look into the the slide presentation that I presented at the 2019 AIAA Scitec.

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on unusual propulsion ideas, says he gave a slide presentation in 2019 at AIAA SciTech, a major aerospace engineering conference. He tells listeners to look at slides 4 to 9 of that talk to understand his ideas, which he presents as pointing toward craft like those reported as UFOs.
